using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;
using Duckov.Buffs;
namespace UnityEngine
{
    class GameObject { }
    class Transform { public Vector3 position; }
    struct Vector3
    {
        public float x,y,z; public float sqrMagnitude {get{return x*x+y*y+z*z;}}
        public Vector3 normalized {get{return this;}}
        public static Vector3 operator -(Vector3 a,Vector3 b){return new Vector3{x=a.x-b.x,y=a.y-b.y,z=a.z-b.z};}
    }
    class Collider { public DamageReceiver Receiver; }
    static class Physics
    {
        internal static Collider[] Results; internal static int NonAlloc,Full;
        public static int OverlapSphereNonAlloc(Vector3 origin,float radius,Collider[] buffer,int mask)
        {NonAlloc++;int n=Math.Min(buffer.Length,Results.Length);Array.Copy(Results,buffer,n);return n;}
        public static Collider[] OverlapSphere(Vector3 origin,float radius,int mask){Full++;return (Collider[])Results.Clone();}
    }
}
namespace Duckov.Buffs {class Buff {}}
class CharacterMainControl {public int Team;public GameObject gameObject=new GameObject();public int Buffs;public void AddBuff(Buff b,CharacterMainControl source,int id){Buffs++;}}
static class Team {public static bool IsEnemy(int a,int b){return a!=b;}}
class Health {public bool IsDead;public CharacterMainControl Character;public CharacterMainControl TryGetCharacter(){return Character;}}
enum DamageTypes {normal}
enum ElementTypes {ghost}
class DamageInfo
{
    public CharacterMainControl source;public DamageInfo(CharacterMainControl c){source=c;}
    public DamageTypes damageType;public float damageValue;public Vector3 damagePoint,damageNormal;public int fromWeaponItemID,crit;public bool isFromBuffOrEffect;public float Ghost;
    public void AddElementFactor(ElementTypes type,float v){Ghost=v;}
}
class DamageReceiver
{
    static int next;int id=++next;public int Team;public Health health=new Health();public Transform transform=new Transform();public int Hits;public DamageInfo Last;
    public int GetInstanceID(){return id;}public void Hurt(DamageInfo damage){Hits++;Last=damage;}
}
namespace BossRush
{
    static class ModBehaviour {internal static void DevLog(string s){throw new Exception(s);}}
    static class PhantomWitchScytheIds {internal const int WeaponTypeId=500044;}
    static class PhantomWitchAssetManager {internal static Buff GetCurseBuff(){return new Buff();}}
    static class PhantomWitchCurseSweatVfx {internal static void TryAttach(GameObject g){}}
    static class FenHuangHalberdRuntime {internal static int DamageReceiverLayerMask=1;internal static DamageReceiver TryGetDamageReceiver(Collider c){return c.Receiver;}}
    sealed class ModeGTelemetrySuppressionScope:IDisposable {internal static IDisposable Enter(Health h){return new ModeGTelemetrySuppressionScope();}public void Dispose(){}}
    class PhantomWitchCurseRealmRuntime
    {
        /* REALM_FIELDS */
        private Vector3 realmOrigin;private CharacterMainControl caster;private float overrideRadius=4,overrideDamagePerTick=22;
        internal void Pulse(CharacterMainControl owner){caster=owner;DealRealmDamage();}
        /* REALM_METHODS */
    }
}
class Program
{
    static int checks;static void Check(bool ok,string message){checks++;if(!ok)throw new Exception(message);}
    static DamageReceiver Receiver(int team,bool character=true){return new DamageReceiver{Team=team,health=new Health{Character=character?new CharacterMainControl{Team=team}:null}};}
    static void Main()
    {
        var guest=new CharacterMainControl{Team=1};var realm=new BossRush.PhantomWitchCurseRealmRuntime();
        var receivers=new List<DamageReceiver>();var colliders=new List<Collider>();
        for(int i=0;i<90;i++){var target=Receiver(2);receivers.Add(target);colliders.Add(new Collider{Receiver=target});colliders.Add(new Collider{Receiver=target});}
        var friendly=Receiver(1);colliders.Insert(0,new Collider{Receiver=friendly});
        var prop=Receiver(2,false);colliders.Insert(0,new Collider{Receiver=prop});
        var far=Receiver(2);far.transform.position=new Vector3{x=10};colliders.Insert(0,new Collider{Receiver=far});
        var dead=Receiver(2);dead.health.IsDead=true;colliders.Insert(0,new Collider{Receiver=dead});
        Physics.Results=colliders.ToArray();realm.Pulse(guest);
        foreach(var receiver in receivers)Check(receiver.Hits==1&&receiver.health.Character.Buffs==1,"complete dense query damages every enemy once despite duplicate colliders");
        Check(friendly.Hits==0&&prop.Hits==0&&far.Hits==0&&dead.Hits==0,"actual team character distance and death filters preserved");
        Check(receivers[89].Last.source==guest&&receivers[89].Last.damageValue==22&&receivers[89].Last.Ghost==1&&receivers[89].Last.isFromBuffOrEffect,"guest weapon retains actual personal damage attribution and tuning");
        int oldQueries=Physics.NonAlloc;realm.Pulse(guest);Check(Physics.NonAlloc==oldQueries+1&&receivers[89].Hits==2,"grown buffer is reused on the next damage interval");
        Physics.Results=new Collider[1050];for(int i=0;i<1049;i++)Physics.Results[i]=new Collider{Receiver=prop};var last=Receiver(2);Physics.Results[1049]=new Collider{Receiver=last};
        realm.Pulse(guest);Check(Physics.Full==1&&last.Hits==1&&last.health.Character.Buffs==1,"complete allocating fallback keeps enemies beyond retained buffer capacity");
        for(int i=0;i<16;i++){var player=new CharacterMainControl{Team=1};new BossRush.PhantomWitchCurseRealmRuntime().Pulse(player);Check(last.Last.source==player,"each of sixteen local casters owns its realm hit");}
        oldQueries=Physics.NonAlloc;realm.Pulse(null);Check(Physics.NonAlloc==oldQueries,"destroyed caster exits without physics queries");
        Console.WriteLine("Realm: PASS "+checks+" production damage/query assertions");
    }
}
